# couchbase-capella_app_endpoint_audit_logging_config (Data Source)

The data source to retrieve the audit logging config of an App Endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "couchbase-capella_app_endpoint_audit_logging_config" "existing_app_endpoint_audit_logging_config" {
  organization_id   = "<organization_id>"
  project_id        = "<project_id>"
  cluster_id        = "<cluster_id>"
  app_service_id    = "<app_service_id>"
  app_endpoint_name = "<app_endpoint_name>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_endpoint_name` (String) The name of the App Endpoint.
- `app_service_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the appService.
- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.
- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the project.

### Read-Only

- `audit_enabled` (Boolean) - Determines whether audit logging is enabled
- `disabled_roles` (Attributes Set) The roles that are excluded from audit logging. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disabled_roles))
- `disabled_users` (Attributes Set) The users that are excluded from audit logging. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disabled_users))
- `enabled_event_ids` (Set of Number) The IDs of the audit events that are enabled.

<a id="nestedatt--disabled_roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disabled_roles`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) - Domain of the user/role. Can be used to filter logs by domain. Example values: sgw cbs
- `name` (String) - Name of the user/role
 - **Constraints**: Maximum length: 256 characters


<a id="nestedatt--disabled_users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disabled_users`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) - Domain of the user/role. Can be used to filter logs by domain. Example values: sgw cbs
- `name` (String) - Name of the user/role
 - **Constraints**: Maximum length: 256 characters
